info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Jobs-v2-spec
info.description: The Careers Job Listings API provides access to a comprehensive list of available job positions within the organization. By utilizing this endpoint, consumers can retrieve detailed job descriptions, requirements, and application processes. Ideal for job seekers and HR platforms, this API streamlines the process of browsing and applying for job opportunities. Users can leverage this data to enhance their job search experience and improve recruitment strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve all job applications associated with their account. You can filter and paginate through the list to find specific applications more easily.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving application job details. This should contain the necessary parameters to filter or specify the job applications you are interested in.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to applications and jobs. It is expected to be a string that may carry additional information based on the operation's context.
